title: Sources: Amazon staff find "catastrophically expensive" AI costs due to a lack of controls, like $1.8M on Claude to fail to match author details with listings (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)
summary: Rafe Rosner-Uddin / Financial Times: Sources: Amazon staff find “catastrophically expensive” AI costs due to a lack of controls, like $1.8M on Claude to fail to match author details with listings — E-commerce giant's staff said the new technology had caused budget overruns that sometimes took months to detect
